body_html:
I put it in terms of sheer history. Only in the last 14 years of tens of thousands of years of humanity's literary past have we concentrated all acts of reading and writing in the hands of four companies.

This should scare you.

We need to root #literacies where they have the best chance as tools of empowerment. In communities of marginalized peoples. In schools and libraries.
